IBPS PO vs IBPS RRB: exam pattern compared

IBPS PO has 100 questions in 60 minutes; IBPS RRB has 80 in 45. IBPS PO is marked −¼ of the question’s marks; IBPS RRB +1 / −0.25. In IBPS PO each section has its own clock (English Language 20 min, Quantitative Aptitude 20 min, Reasoning Ability 20 min); in IBPS RRB each section has its own clock (Reasoning 25 min, Quantitative Aptitude 20 min). IBPS PO has English Language 30, Quantitative Aptitude 35, Reasoning Ability 35; IBPS RRB has Reasoning 40, Quantitative Aptitude 40.

Questions people ask

What is the difference between the IBPS PO and IBPS RRB exam patterns?

IBPS PO has 100 questions in 60 minutes; IBPS RRB has 80 in 45. IBPS PO is marked −¼ of the question’s marks; IBPS RRB +1 / −0.25. In IBPS PO each section has its own clock (English Language 20 min, Quantitative Aptitude 20 min, Reasoning Ability 20 min); in IBPS RRB each section has its own clock (Reasoning 25 min, Quantitative Aptitude 20 min). IBPS PO has English Language 30, Quantitative Aptitude 35, Reasoning Ability 35; IBPS RRB has Reasoning 40, Quantitative Aptitude 40.

Which has stricter negative marking, IBPS PO or IBPS RRB?

Neither: both take away a quarter of a right answer’s marks for each wrong answer (−¼ of the question’s marks and +1 / −0.25).

Can I practise for both IBPS PO and IBPS RRB on Takkar?

Yes. Pick either exam in the app and every duel follows its marking and timing; you can switch exams any time. The quant and reasoning topics overlap a lot, so practice for one helps the other.
